name: twin-service
purpose: Clock, scenarios, health and OpenAPI for synthetic services
usedFor: Standing in for a service you do not own (dining, transit, room booking, a job board, a learning platform) so tests, walks and demos can rely on it, with a contract that a real vendor can later be checked against.
notFor: Production data, services you do own (test the real one), or load testing (it answers in-process and fast).
